title: Site kit engine: niche starter kits a site can apply (first kit: Wildheart, coaches and healers)

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-26: a theme and kit library; each live site's design becomes a theme with generic kits. Plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/KnVnxpTGVzMJ2pUxTVevfi

detail: Phase 1 of the theme and kit library. A kit is typed code under lib/sites/kits (pages, sample copy, SEO, chrome) with a light index and an on-demand loader that the public site never imports. applyKit is a pure function over a website draft with three modes (theme, add, replace), never leaves a half-applied site, refuses past 30 pages, flags every block as sample, and renames clashing slugs. Not wired to the editor yet (phase 2: library screen, preview, undo as one editor step). Kits only target themes in WEBSITE_THEMES_LIVE; Default kits wait for the owner's preview sign-off on the Default render (LIVE-892 gate).

verify.evidence: No lib/sites/kits tests exist on main; the suite is added by this row.
